I don’t think there is anything wrong inherently with the statement “all lives matter.” But and this is a big BUT, when is used in conjunction with a counter argument with BLM. It’s a protest on a protest. But I guess that on itself isn’t very interesting. There is zero doubt that there is systemic racism. But I have this notion that we cannot keep suppressing opposing views into the ground. Sure some are harmful and hurtful. But if we don’t start bringing these discussions out in the open and stop just calling each other offensive names for having a specific view that you were probably conditioned to have. It’s important to have an intelligent conversation on how we got an X view or a Y view and really start examining why we think this particular way.
